Previous lessons:
Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning path choice screens was helpful (+12.0%, p=0.0), far exceeding predictions (+1.0%).
Adding new screens (new_screen), new guidance flows (new_flow), or path hints (hint) showed no clear effect.
Changing copy (copy), reordering steps (reorder), or adding status indicators/animations showed no clear effect.
Predictions for copy changes, step reordering, hints, and new screens/flows were consistently too high, while predictions for path choice redesign were too low.

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), closely matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning the path choice screen was helpful (+12.0%, p=0.0), far exceeding the prediction (+1.0%).
New flows can be harmful; a post-setup launcher flow significantly reduced completion (-19.6%, p=0.001), while other new flows showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens, path hints, copy changes, step reordering, status indicators, notification toggles, and animations showed no clear effect.
Predictions for path choice redesign were far too low, while predictions for new flows, new screens, step reordering, hints, and copy changes were consistently too high.
